lines: d33: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Christian Knight is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d33: 🕯️ Christian Knight is dead — the wild. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d33: What Christian kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d33: "Christian's gone." Eric looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Christian." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d33: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Darius blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d33: 📖 LEARNED: Steady Hands (Level 1). Fine work under pressure. Dressing game, stitching wounds, tying snares — no shake.
d33: 📖 LEARNED: Patient Aim (Level 1). One shot. You don't take the shot unless it's the shot.
d33: 📖 LEARNED: Wound Care (Level 1). Clean it, close it, cover it. Pressure stops bleeding. Clean water is better than dirty hands.
d33: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Precise Mend! Your healing knows where to go. +50% effectiveness. (Your knowledge of Wound Care amplifies your field_medicine.)
d33: 📖 LEARNED: Animal Behavior (Level 1). Most animals flee. Give them an escape route and they take it. Cornered animals fight.
d33: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Tracks (Level 1). Fresh tracks have sharp edges. Old tracks crumble. You can tell how recently something passed.
d33: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d33: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Christian Knight, 33 days. The mantle passes to Darius Pillai.
d33: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Darius Pillai, 58 — a Dentist. His hands know different work now: Beast-calm, Green Whisper, Green Thumb, Literally.
d33: The village's quarrel was with Christian — and Christian is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d33: At the grave, Eric, Babatunde, Shyngys and 2 more speak for Darius — "Christian trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d33: The fire knew Darius before the Codex did — his name already carried weight here.
